title: Counter potential identity
statement: Let $w$ be a Boolean word and let $r$ be a natural number no greater than the binary value of $w$. Then the counter overhead after $r$ iterations plus twice the number of true entries in $w$ equals four times $r$ plus twice the number of true entries in the counter word after $r$ iterations.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is at most the binary value of $w$
